offering_description.value: Provides oilfield services and equipment to oil and gas exploration and production companies worldwide. Delivers drilling, completion, well construction, fracturing and production services using its own fleets, tools, chemicals and engineers.

primary_products.value: drilling tools and bits; completion tools; drilling and completion fluids; artificial lift equipment; proppant and chemicals

primary_services.value: hydraulic fracturing; well construction and cementing; drilling services; wireline and completion services; reservoir and production optimization

customer_segment.value: B2B: international oil companies, independent producers, national oil companies

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; onshore and offshore energy

revenue_model.value: service fees: fracturing, cementing, drilling and well services billed per job or usage; product sales: completion tools, drill bits, chemicals and artificial lift equipment; project or contract: integrated multi-year well and project contracts
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: supplies well construction and stimulation services to oil and gas producers; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures drilling and completion tools and chemicals from purchased materials, sold to energy operators; asset operator: operates fracturing fleets, rigs-related equipment and service vehicles
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe/Africa, Middle East and Asia Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: completion and production services plus well construction and drilling services for oil and gas

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams and field service operations serving oil and gas operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, safety and hydraulic fracturing rules from EPA, OSHA, and international and state regulators, export and sanctions controls
